messages:
jordan: noticing weird SSO failures since 02:10 UTC, ~5% of logins failing with `SAML assertion decryption failed` errors in auth logs. SCIM delta shows backlog and some users stuck in 'provisioning' state. Any ideas? :eyes:

lia: saw alerts, thanks. Do we have sample log lines? Also did KMS key rotation happen last night?

jordan: attaching snippet from auth-service logs:
```
2026-02-25T02:08:19Z auth[pid=321]: ERROR SAML: Assertion decryption failed: xmlsec: crypto error (bad decrypt)
2026-02-25T02:08:20Z auth[pid=321]: WARN SAML: Audience check failed for issuer=https://idp.example.com
```

sam: hmm looks like SP private key can't decrypt assertions. KMS rotate ran at 01:58 — did we update the key in the SP config? @maya do you have the rotation PR link?

maya: yes we rotated the KMS key (alias/redwood-sso) during maintenance. I updated the Key ID in the KMS UI but didn't update the service secret that holds the wrapped key. Oops. Rolling back now.

scim-sync-bot: Delta sync started: queued 1,234 changes. Completed: 12 users updated, 43 failed, 5 pending.

lia: that matches the provisioning failures. When SSO fails users won't be created/linked via SCIM because our pipeline short-circuits on SSO lookup. If we fix decryption users should reconcile.

henry: putting remediation steps here:
1) rollback KMS key alias to previous version (or rewrap SP private key with new KMS key)
2) restart auth-service (graceful)
3) run `scim full-sync --force --since 2026-02-24T00:00Z`
4) monitor audit logs for `UserProvisioningFailure` events

sam: also double-check SAML metadata: IdP started sending encrypted assertions only after their config change. If SP not set to accept encrypted assertions we'll see decrypt failures.

maya: rollback done, rewrapped key, restarting auth-service now :rocket:

deploy-bot: auth-service deployment v2.14.3 -> v2.14.4 triggered by maya (restart), status: rolling

jordan: auth-service back up, initial smoke shows login success for previously failing users. Running scim full-sync now.

scim-sync-bot: Full sync finished: 1,234 created/updated, 0 failed.

lia: great. Two follow-ups:
- Add a pre-rotation checklist for KMS key rotations (update wrapped secrets in services + run test decrypt)
- Add audit alert for `Assertion decryption failed` threshold > 1% in 5m

henry: logging ticket in security board and marking as sev3 incident; triage notes + root cause = KMS rotate without secret rewrap. CVE? none. marking as postmortem required if recurrence.

jordan: thanks all. I'll add the user impact summary and timestamps to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident #INC-2026-142 created, assigned to eng-security, priority P3, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-142

maya: adding runbook step to rewrap SP key and test with `samltool validate` before rotation.

sam: perfect. Closing thread after ticket updates. :white_check_mark:
